# `Scanner/ArtefactClinic-v0` · Artefact clinic: diagnose the marked findings and correct the protocol

**Status:** ADMITTED: on 300 fresh instances per level the reference passes >= 99 %, no policy that ignores the object passes more than 7 % (95 % bounds)

An examination with look-alike findings: chemical-shift displacement, opposed-phase cancellation, truncation ringing, wrap-around, a motion ghost, susceptibility signal loss, or the object itself. At levels 1 and 2 one experiment separates each pair (other bandwidth, other echo time, finer matrix, more phase field of view). At level 3 the findings of an episode look alike, two experiments tell the three possibilities of a look apart (half the slice and the in-phase echo; phase oversampling and one average), the budget holds the first look and two experiments, and two remedies have a dose that an experiment measures. Every remedy costs scan time or signal-to-noise ratio, and the requirements do not leave room for all of them. How images are read: the reference policy reads single pixels of stored images inside each finding. A text-only agent gets the same numbers from `read_regions`: a circle of radius 1 mm on a pixel centre (centre + (i - n // 2) x field of view / n) returns that pixel alone when pixels are larger than 1 mm, which holds for every experiment of the reference (matrix at most 224 on a 240 mm field of view); 16 circles per call, free of charge. At level 3 the reference also reads two phase images (`view` with kind phase; `read_regions` returns the complex mean of a circle): the complex difference of the complaint and the one-average scan along the phase-encode line of a ghost finding shows where its copies went. Task kind by the stored gate: level 1 a measurement task, level 2 a measurement task, level 3 a measurement task (measurement: a fixed scan list with a fixed estimator passes within 25 points of the reference).

Kind of task: **{1: 'measurement', 2: 'measurement', 3: 'measurement'}**.

```python

env = mrgym.make("Scanner/ArtefactClinic-v0", level=2, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| A test object with hidden materials, the protocol of an examination, findings a reader marked on its image, the requirements of the examination; scan time for experiments | For each finding its causes (or none: it is the object), and one protocol that images every finding cleanly inside the requirements | Noise-free re-scan of the delivered protocol on the hidden object against its counterfactual twins (the same protocol with the artefact mechanisms switched off, and the object averaged over each pixel); the diagnosis against the mechanisms that corrupt each finding in the complaint protocol |

## World

- On the table: QA phantom, 1.5 T or 3 T. Levels 1 and 2: a gel body with a ring of vials, two of them oil. Level 3: an elongated gel body with placed vials (dark, bright, a mixture of water and fat, one that pulses), tubes beside it, patches of through-slice field gradient
- Sequences that matter here: spgr
- Formulas the agent is given: chemical_shift_displacement: fat appears -polarity x 3.4 ppm x gamma x B0 / bandwidth_hz_per_px pixels along the readout; opposed_phase_cancellation: a pixel that holds water w and fat f shows |w + f c(TE)|, c = sum_p a_p exp(2 pi i f_p TE); minima near (k + 1/2) / (3.4 ppm x gamma x B0): 2.3, 6.8 ms at 1.5 T; 1.1, 3.4 ms at 3 T; gradient echo only; truncation_ringing: sinc point-spread function of the sampled k-space: 9 % overshoot of a step, ripple period 2 pixels; wrap_around: shown position = position modulo the phase field of view: what lies beyond it folds in from the other side; periodic_motion_ghost: a structure whose signal pulses with frequency f appears again at +- frac(f x TR x averages) x the encoded phase field of view along the phase-encode axis, whatever the direction of the motion; susceptibility_signal_loss: gradient echo: signal x the dephasing factor of G x dz x TE cycles across the slice profile (hard pulse: exp(-(pi G dz TE)^2 / (4 ln 2))), G the through-slice field gradient in Hz/mm, dz the slice

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| which vials hold oil; T1, T2, proton density of every material | the complaint protocol and its header line |
| the extent of the object and what lies beside it | the findings and the reference region (circles) |
| which mechanism reaches which finding | the requirements: scan time, pixel size, SNR, TE window, locked parameters |
| level 3: which vial pulses and how fast, where the through-slice gradient is and how strong | the vocabulary of causes |
| noise level | the instrument datasheet; realised protocol, timing and cost of every plan and scan |
| the 128-bit world seed |  |

## Levels

| Level | Covered by the claim | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | yes | four findings, each with at most one cause from a small set: the one fat mechanism the protocol arms, or truncation, or none (the finding is the object); budget 1.5 x the scan time of the reference's experiments, always less than one run of the complaint protocol | 57 to 65 |
| 2 | yes | four findings from the look-alike set of four causes: the armed fat mechanism, truncation, wrap-around, or the object itself (a real edge or another material next to the artefacts); less scan time; budget 1.3 x the scan time of the reference's experiments, always less than one run of the complaint protocol | 65 to 74 |
| 3 | yes | four findings that look alike, all darker or all brighter than the gel. Dark: susceptibility signal loss, opposed-phase cancellation in a material that holds water and fat, or a material that is dark. Bright: a folded copy of a tube beside the object, a ghost copy of a vial that pulses, or a vial that is bright. Every episode holds both artefact causes of its look at least once; position and sheet are drawn independently of the causes. Two single-change experiments tell the three apart, and which two depends on the look (one scan can carry changes for both looks, so a fixed list of three scans serves either: see the open-loop control); the remedies have doses that the experiments measure (the slice from the measured loss at the echo time of the remedy, the averages from the measured displacement of the copy), and the delivered protocol needs a stated share of the SNR of the best clean protocol, so a dose stronger than needed fails as well. Every scan costs at least the console's 7 s of overhead and dummy cycles, and the budget is below four times that: the first look and two experiments. Not served here: chemical-shift displacement (it needs an in-phase echo and a low bandwidth, the cancellation an opposed echo) and truncation (at this pixel size doubling the matrix does not clean it); budget: the first look and the two experiments of the costlier look, never more than four times the 7 s every scan costs before its first line; cost of the minimal battery that diagnoses without looking / budget = 1.56 (median of 24 stored instances) | 26 to 27 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'causes': {'<finding id>': ['<cause>']}, 'protocol': {'<parameter>': '<value>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; the console accepts the delivered protocol
- Error: `largest over the findings of E / threshold on the delivered protocol; E = mean absolute difference to the twin, relative to the twin, inside the finding`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates; every finding diagnosed exactly; every finding clean (E <= 0.05 against the mechanism-free twin, <= 0.03 against the pixel-averaged object); scan time, pixel size, SNR, TE window and locked parameters as required (level 3: the SNR floor is a stated share of the SNR of the verified remedy, a number the card does not print)

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier's scans are noise-free.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
